author: Luciano Rezzolla and Olindo Zanotti
title: An Improved Exact Riemann Solver for Relativistic Hydrodynamics
review_scope: Original arxiv v2 read: sections2–4, equations2.3/2.4,3.1 and4.5; restricted two-shock specialization. No whole-paper or generic Riemann implementation audit.

review.ja: 原著プレプリントの2–4節、状態方程式、相対速度式3.1とTaub二次式4.5を直接確認。対称二衝撃波への特殊化です。
review.en: Read original preprint sections2–4: EOS, relative-velocity equation3.1 and Taub quadratic4.5. Restricted symmetric two-shock specialization.

author: L. Del Zanna, O. Zanotti, N. Bucciantini and P. Londrillo
title: ECHO: a Eulerian Conservative High Order scheme for general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics and magnetodynamics
review_scope: University-hosted original journal PDF section4.1 equations82–85 read; original arxiv preprint pages9–10 rendered and visually inspected, including normalization and period. Publisher PDF403. No whole-paper or ECHO-algorithm reproduction claim.

review.ja: 大学リポジトリの原著4.1節・式82–85を読み、原著プレプリント9–10頁の式・規格化・周期を描画して目視確認。ECHO法自体の再現ではありません。
review.en: Read original journal section4.1 equations82–85 via the university repository; rendered and visually inspected original preprint pages9–10, including normalization and period. No ECHO-algorithm reproduction.

author: José A. Font
title: Numerical Hydrodynamics and Magnetohydrodynamics in General Relativity
review_scope: Official article sections3.1–3.2, tensor49–51 and recovery68–69 actually read. Flat-spacetime use only; no whole-review or complete-GRMHD implementation audit.

review.ja: 公式の著者レビュー3.1–3.2節、テンソル式49–51と変換式68–69を直接確認。平坦時空の実装に使用します。
review.en: Read official author-review sections3.1–3.2, stress tensor49–51 and recovery68–69; flat-spacetime use only.
